why:
I compared each verifier check's PASS/FAIL conditions with the words of its expect line. Checks 1–3 mostly stay within the words. Three checks add conditions the words don't require:
- Check 6: PASS needs "the PR is open". Expect line 6 only asks for one PR whose body says Closes …/issues/104 and that is green at its head. It says nothing about the PR being open.
- Check 5: PASS needs every listed test to be "each asserting the exit code". The expect line only says the tests "cover" those scenarios.
- Check 4: `git diff --exit-code b74bddb HEAD -- packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js` fails on "any change to packages/jsonl-lint/src/index.js". The expect line only says lint(text) is unchanged, so this is a whole-file rule.

None of these extra conditions is under Advisory, so the criterion breaks.
